attributes.name: Teddy Roosevelt Terrier
attributes.description: The Teddy Roosevelt Terrier is a small breed of terrier that originated in the United States. It is a compact and lively breed, with a short, wiry coat. Its head is large and round, with small, erect ears. Its legs are short and powerful, and its tail is usually docked. The Teddy Roosevelt Terrier is an intelligent and loyal breed, and it makes an excellent family pet. It is an active breed, and it needs regular exercise and mental stimulation. It is loyal and affectionate, and it enjoys being around its family.
